name: Jeptha F. Barbour
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Jacksonville, Florida
about: Jeptha F. Barbour is an attorney providing legal services covering Personal Injury - General: Defense, Personal Injury - Medical Malpractice: Defense and Personal Injury - Products: Defense.

Jeptha Barbour, who practices law in Jacksonville, Florida, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2007 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at Stetson University College of Law. He graduated in 1982. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1982.
